papers.title_en: Fast Gauss Sums via Flash Attention
papers.evidence: 复用Flash Attention实现线性内存的核求和
papers.tldr: 高斯核求和是MMD、核梯度流与SVGD等方法的核心计算，但高效实现通常依赖专用GPU代码。本文提出用Flash Attention计算带任意有符号权重的高斯核求和：仅对输入做两次小型增广，就把归一化softmax归约转化为非归一化高斯和，无需编写定制GPU内核。在fp16且特征维度D>8时，该方法在速度、显存开销与精度上常显著优于编译PyTorch和PyKeOps，并保持线性显存扩展。这为核方法提供了复用注意力优化生态的通用加速途径。
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian kernel sums are the computational core of maximum mean discrepancies (MMDs), kernel gradient flows, Stein variational gradient descent (SVGD), and many other kernel methods. At the same time, softmax attention has received an extraordinary amount of hardware-aware code engineering, culminating in flash attention. We show that Gauss kernel sums with arbitrary, signed weights can be evaluated via flash attention: two small input augmentations turn the normalized softmax reduction into the unnormalized Gauss sum, without writing a single line of custom GPU code. For feature dimension D>8 in fp16, this approach beats compiled PyTorch code as well as PyKeOps kernels (often significantly) in speed, memory-overhead and accuracy. Indeed, its memory scaling remains linear.
